Entries.Source: I find myself in the test hall, at noon, and it feels like a parallel to the storm I pushed through until my legs gave out. The brewer of the coast stands as a man, reminiscent of the strict tutor who guided my lessons. I catch the eye of the brewer by the coast, a man whose presence feels as familiar as the scent of smoke from the hearth. His scrutiny mirrors my own childhood vigilance, as if he were a tutor assessing the lessons I carry.

I sense a man taps a cask, his brow furrowed as he sniffs the froth. Alone in the room, he already questions before I've begun to speak. I note his attire, his carry, and wish to engage. How do I start this conversation? With overwhelming force, perhaps?
I smashed through the silence, my voice a thunderous roar that made his ears ring. With brute force, I forced the conversation, crushing Aeemilyus's hesitation like a spider beneath a boot. Success!
Modus mentis practised: Childhood Reminescence (1/12 xp)
Modus mentis practised: Brute Force (1/12 xp)
Day well spent. Have we not crossed paths but once?
Ernaeulht the White speaks, as he must.
Ernaeulht the White, to the point, as is fitting for one who knows where the ale is brewed. The benches by the mash-tub, they belong to me.
Joyful to encounter thee. Let not my presence hinder thine tasks.
Until next time, courteous, and you know when to tread with care.

I follow Aeemilyus, the brewer of the coast, as he taps a cask and sniffs the froth, brow furrowed in judgement. He is the only one in the room with nothing in front of them, already asking me something before I have finished arriving. I take careful note of what he is wearing and what he is carrying, drawing a quiet parallel between now and the stormy days when I pushed through until my legs gave out.

I question what he knows of his work and of this place, already noting his judgment and my own readiness to be led. I will ask, relying on the welcoming and care of guests and travellers, as we are taught.

I began to sit, my hands already drying the guest's wet cloak, and soon found myself speaking with Aeemilyus about his journey and the mysteries of this place. It felt right, as if this was always meant to be. Thankful for the success of my greeting, I welcomed Aeemilyus's presence with ease.
Modus mentis practised: Social Interaction (1/12 xp)
Modus mentis practised: Childhood Reminescence (2/12 xp)
Something you seek to know, indeed.
Speak of the folk we meet, how do they fare, and where do they come from?
There be folk, scarce few, whom I well know.
Who here would ye believe in a lie?
Two of them, indeed, and I'll wager you cannot guess which two to keep a vigilant eye upon.

It seems you seek to learn much.
Speak of your tasks, let me hear of your labours.
In the ale, flavors of the earth do mingle, steeped in my hands and seasoned with years of care.
And what did they teach you, and where did you learn it?
Wrong as I am, I yet teach a novice how I do this trade.

And yet, my dear friend, my name is indeed Ernaeulht the White.
Ernaeulht the White, you get straight to the point. The benches by the mash-tub belong to me, as do the ale they offer.

How is your heart's keeping, Aeemilyus?
Well enough, but what do you think of the ale, and how does it affect one's health? The strong stuff in the afternoons is like a thief in the night, and what say you about it?

Farewell, and know that your care is deeply cherished.
